description: Search Swedish parliamentary documents, speeches, votes, members, and statutes via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Search Swedish parliamentary documents, speeches, votes, members, and statutes via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
interface.longDescription: Search Riksdagen open data: bills, motions, committee reports, and consolidated SFS statutes with their decisions, references, and paged text. Trace committee report points to published main votes by party, read a member's session votes and chamber speeches, and look up member register entries and assignment histories. Keyless; responses carry source attribution, effective filters, and complete continuation calls.
